item.title: The preliminary Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature for October…
item.author: Prof. Eliot Jacobson (@climatecasino.net)
item.description:
The preliminary Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature for October 13 just broke 30°C for the third time, and is now 3.3°C above the 1991-2020 baseline.

This marks the 22nd consecutive daily temperature above the previous all-time record high of 29.815°C. set on Nov. 17, 2015.
